title: R2-SEC4: wrl.13 resolved
description: wrl.13: 'An account that does not broadcast its own read times does not observe others' read times in the affected scope.' The 'in the affected scope' qualifier was added in the R1 fix wave. The Receiver Behavior in the federation spec (draft-atwood-jmap-chat-federation-00.md:315) confirms the server MUST NOT deliver readAt to the owner's clients when receiptSharing is false, while explicitly allowing deliveredAt to still be recorded. The sentence is now accurate: it says 'read times' (not delivery timestamps), and the scope qualifier correctly limits the claim to the affected chat or account level. No further action needed.
close_reason: wrl.13 resolved by 'in the affected scope' qualifier
